subject: general
question: Laughing gas, used by doctors as Anaesthesia, is ________
solution:
The correct answer is __**nitrous oxide**__.

__
 
• Laughing gas, used by doctors as anaesthesia is nitrous__ __oxide__.
 
• Laughing gas is a colourless and odourless sweet-smelling gas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nitrous oxide was discovered by Joseph Priestly in 1793.
 
• **Nitrous oxide**, is a chemical compound, an oxide of nitrogen with the** **formula **N2O**.
 
• It is a non-flammable gas.
 
• It is soluble in water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nitrogen is the chemical element with the **symbol N.**
 
• It has the **atomic number 7.**
 
• The Earth's atmosphere is 78% nitrogen gas.
